aliases: Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Tusi
name: Nasir al-Din al-Tusi
summary: Medieval Persian polymath, astronomer, and mathematician known for the Maragheh Observatory and Zij Ilkhani tables.

name: Hulagu Khan
summary: Mongol ruler who freed Tusi and commissioned the Maragheh Observatory.

name: Maragheh Observatory
summary: Major 13th-century astronomical research center founded by Tusi in South Azerbaijan.

name: Alamut fortress
summary: Fortress where Tusi was imprisoned for over 20 years.

name: Tus
summary: City in Iran from which Tusi originated.

name: Nishapur
summary: City where Tusi moved to continue his education.

name: Baghdad
summary: City where Tusi died and was buried.

name: Zij Ilkhani
summary: Astronomical tables and star catalog compiled from 12 years of observations at Maragheh.

name: Akhlaki-Nasiri
summary: Ethical treatise completed by Tusi in 1235.

name: Farid al-Din Damadi al Nishapuri
summary: Philosopher and main teacher of Tusi in logic.

name: Qutb al-Din al-Misri
summary: Scholar under whom Tusi studied medicine and philosophy.

name: Muayid ad-Din Urdi
summary: Scientist from Damascus who assisted in the construction of Maragheh Observatory.

name: Fakhr ad-Din Maragi
summary: Doctor and mathematician from Mosul who worked at Maragheh Observatory.
